lastCompletedStory.title: Delete the unread readPermissionMode module and its stale cross-references

nextStoryContext: US-002 (CAM-458) deleted src/config/permission-mode.ts (DEFAULT_PERMISSION_MODE, readPermissionMode) outright: the module had zero real importers, only comment mentions. All comment cross-references were reworded to state the fact directly (permission mode is a hardcoded bypassPermissions literal at each of the 5 claude spawn sites: run.ts:392, setup.ts:480/:561, sidecar.ts:1569, plan-runner.ts:1312) instead of naming the now-deleted module: src/config/models.ts:6/:11/:146, src/config/toolchain.ts:18, src/commands/run.ts:609-613, index.ts:11-17, test/no-permission-mode-flag.test.ts:3-6. Also removed the knip ignore entry and the file-size-budget.json entry for the deleted file, and repointed scripts/cam/patterns.md:1004's security-posture bullet away from the deleted file path. The no-CLI-flag invariant (test/no-permission-mode-flag.test.ts) is untouched behaviorally, only its header comment changed, and still passes. Gotcha for any future negative-grep oracle sweeping src/index.ts/test: it also caught scripts/file-size-budget.json's own budget key (the string appears as a JSON key, not just in prose) and src/commands/run.ts's own line-count growing past its file-size ceiling by +1 line from the comment reword -- raised 1168->1169 with a dated _ref entry, staged before re-running the gate (the tracker-ref check reads the staged diff, not the working tree). Historical/state files (scripts/cam/prd.json, review-artifact.txt, review-report.json, plan-verdict-report.json, journal.md, issues/*.json) still contain the literal tokens in dated narrative/audit text; these are out of the story's oracle scope (src/, index.ts, test/ only) and were deliberately left untouched as historical record.
